bugs.title: Edge detection inverted and no debounce
bugs.description: risingEdge() at lines 26-29 returns true only on LOW-to-HIGH, so the LED toggles on release rather than on the active-LOW press, and the loop at lines 52-58 acts on every raw sample with no 40 ms settle window. Measured evidence shows presses toggling D13 2-3 times each (e.g. "press at 800 ms toggled D13 2 time(s), expected exactly 1") and spurious toggles with no press ("D13 toggled at 952 ms with no press to explain it"). Bounce on both edges is therefore counted as multiple edges, and the required 40 ms debounce is entirely absent. 15 of 15 press(es) did not toggle D13 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [2, 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2]. D13 also toggled 9 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 952 ms.
